articles.title: Sheetz opens fourth Lebanon County location
articles.summary: Sheetz opened its fourth Lebanon County store featuring a made-to-order menu, grand opening giveaways, and donations to local nonprofits. The post Sheetz opens fourth Lebanon County location appeared first on Central Penn Business Journal .

articles.title: Popular Italian restaurant expands to Dauphin County: ‘We have a lot of passion’
articles.summary: Luna Italian Cuisine opened its second location in Susquehanna Township last night.

articles.title: Charter Senior Living Breaks Ground on 162-Unit Project in West Chester, Pennsylvania
articles.summary: WEST CHESTER, PA. — Charter Senior Living has broken ground on a 162-unit project in West Chester, located roughly 30 miles west of Philadelphia. Charter Senior Living of West Chester will offer independent living, assisted living and memory care residences. Charter is developing the project in partnership with Paradise Management. Completion is scheduled for late next year. The post Charter Senior Living Breaks Ground on 162-Unit Project in West Chester, Pennsylvania appeared first on REBusines

articles.title: This taxpayer-funded warehouse is key to Philly port's expansion. But who gets to work there?
articles.summary: Pennsylvania invested $85 million to build a new warehouse near the Packer Avenue Marine Terminal in South Philadelphia. Labor unions are at odds over which workers should get the jobs.

articles.title: PLCB opens bids for expired restaurant licenses in 20 counties, including Lehigh Valley
articles.summary: The Pennsylvania Liquor Control Board is accepting sealed bids for expired restaurant licenses in 20 counties, including the Lehigh Valley.
